--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,41 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError("Input must be a numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError("Input must be a 2D matrix")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError("Input must not be empty")
+        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
+            raise ValueError("Input must be finite")
+        if (arr > 0).any():
+            raise ValueError("Input must be nonpositive")
+    # Check shapes match
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
+    # Validate tau_filter
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
+    
+    # Compute losses: negative sum over future horizon
+    loss_with_result = -np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
+    loss_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    loss_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
+    
+    # Compute best alternative loss
+    best_alternative = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
+    # Compute margin
+    margin = best_alternative - loss_with_result
+    # Keep if margin > tau
+    keep = margin > tau_filter
+    
+    return keep, margin
